description: Parameter sweep leaderboard. Select a session, then use the dropdowns to filter runs by config_json parameters. All KPI panels and the leaderboard table update live as you change filters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT total_runs AS "Total Runs" FROM sweep_sessions WHERE id::text = '${session_id}'

panels.title: Filtered Runs
panels.description: Runs matching all active dropdown filters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Filtered Runs" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE session_id::text = '${session_id}' AND config_json->>'price_entry' IN (${price_entry:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'price_scale' IN (${price_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'amount_scale' IN (${amount_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'number_of_orders' IN (${number_of_orders:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' IN (${take_profit_distance_percent:singlequote})

SELECT ROUND(MAX(roi)::numeric, 4) AS "Best ROI" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE session_id::text = '${session_id}' AND config_json->>'price_entry' IN (${price_entry:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'price_scale' IN (${price_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'amount_scale' IN (${amount_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'number_of_orders' IN (${number_of_orders:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' IN (${take_profit_distance_percent:singlequote})

SELECT ROUND(AVG(roi)::numeric, 4) AS "Avg ROI" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE session_id::text = '${session_id}' AND config_json->>'price_entry' IN (${price_entry:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'price_scale' IN (${price_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'amount_scale' IN (${amount_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'number_of_orders' IN (${number_of_orders:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' IN (${take_profit_distance_percent:singlequote})

SELECT ROUND(AVG(max_drawdown)::numeric, 4) AS "Avg Drawdown" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE session_id::text = '${session_id}' AND config_json->>'price_entry' IN (${price_entry:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'price_scale' IN (${price_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'amount_scale' IN (${amount_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'number_of_orders' IN (${number_of_orders:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' IN (${take_profit_distance_percent:singlequote})

SELECT ROUND(AVG(win_rate)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Win Rate" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE session_id::text = '${session_id}' AND config_json->>'price_entry' IN (${price_entry:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'price_scale' IN (${price_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'amount_scale' IN (${amount_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'number_of_orders' IN (${number_of_orders:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' IN (${take_profit_distance_percent:singlequote})

panels.title: Run Leaderboard
panels.description: All matching runs sorted by ROI descending. Config parameters are extracted from config_json as individual columns. Capped at 2000 rows — add more filters to narrow down. Click a Run ID to open its Narrow Events Timeline.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_id::text AS "Run ID", ROUND(roi::numeric, 4) AS "ROI %", ROUND(max_drawdown::numeric, 4) AS "Max Drawdown %", ROUND(total_fees::numeric, 6) AS "Total Fees", ROUND(win_rate::numeric, 2) AS "Win Rate %", ROUND(capital_efficiency::numeric, 4) AS "Cap. Efficiency", execution_time_ms AS "Exec (ms)", config_json->>'price_entry' AS "Price Entry", config_json->>'price_scale' AS "Price Scale", config_json->>'amount_scale' AS "Amount Scale", (config_json->>'number_of_orders')::int AS "# Orders", config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' AS "TP %" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE session_id::text = '${session_id}' AND config_json->>'price_entry' IN (${price_entry:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'price_scale' IN (${price_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'amount_scale' IN (${amount_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'number_of_orders' IN (${number_of_orders:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' IN (${take_profit_distance_percent:singlequote}) ORDER BY roi DESC LIMIT 2000

panels.title: ROI Distribution
panels.description: Distribution of ROI % across all filtered runs. Reveals whether the solution space skews positive or has a long tail.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(roi::numeric, 2) AS "ROI %" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE session_id::text = '${session_id}' AND config_json->>'price_entry' IN (${price_entry:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'price_scale' IN (${price_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'amount_scale' IN (${amount_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'number_of_orders' IN (${number_of_orders:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' IN (${take_profit_distance_percent:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avg ROI by Take Profit %
panels.description: Average ROI for each take_profit_distance_percent value. Shows which TP level captures the most profit on average.

targets.rawSql: SELECT config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' AS "TP %", ROUND(AVG(roi)::numeric, 4) AS "Avg ROI" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE session_id::text = '${session_id}' AND config_json->>'price_entry' IN (${price_entry:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'price_scale' IN (${price_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'amount_scale' IN (${amount_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'number_of_orders' IN (${number_of_orders:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' IN (${take_profit_distance_percent:singlequote}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY (config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent')::float

panels.title: Avg ROI by # Orders
panels.description: Shows whether more safety orders improve or hurt average ROI.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (config_json->>'number_of_orders')::int AS "# Orders", ROUND(AVG(roi)::numeric, 4) AS "Avg ROI" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE session_id::text = '${session_id}' AND config_json->>'price_entry' IN (${price_entry:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'price_scale' IN (${price_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'amount_scale' IN (${amount_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'number_of_orders' IN (${number_of_orders:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' IN (${take_profit_distance_percent:singlequote}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avg ROI by Price Entry
panels.description: Average ROI by price_entry (deviation % from market when opening a position).

targets.rawSql: SELECT config_json->>'price_entry' AS "Price Entry", ROUND(AVG(roi)::numeric, 4) AS "Avg ROI" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE session_id::text = '${session_id}' AND config_json->>'price_entry' IN (${price_entry:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'price_scale' IN (${price_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'amount_scale' IN (${amount_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'number_of_orders' IN (${number_of_orders:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' IN (${take_profit_distance_percent:singlequote}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY (config_json->>'price_entry')::float

panels.title: Avg ROI by Price Scale
panels.description: Average ROI by price_scale (geometric multiplier between safety order price steps).

targets.rawSql: SELECT config_json->>'price_scale' AS "Price Scale", ROUND(AVG(roi)::numeric, 4) AS "Avg ROI" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE session_id::text = '${session_id}' AND config_json->>'price_entry' IN (${price_entry:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'price_scale' IN (${price_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'amount_scale' IN (${amount_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'number_of_orders' IN (${number_of_orders:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' IN (${take_profit_distance_percent:singlequote}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY (config_json->>'price_scale')::float

panels.title: Avg ROI by Amount Scale
panels.description: Average ROI by amount_scale (geometric multiplier between safety order sizes). Higher = more capital at each level.

targets.rawSql: SELECT config_json->>'amount_scale' AS "Amount Scale", ROUND(AVG(roi)::numeric, 4) AS "Avg ROI" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE session_id::text = '${session_id}' AND config_json->>'price_entry' IN (${price_entry:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'price_scale' IN (${price_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'amount_scale' IN (${amount_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'number_of_orders' IN (${number_of_orders:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' IN (${take_profit_distance_percent:singlequote}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY (config_json->>'amount_scale')::float

panels.title: Top Parameter Combinations
panels.description: Runs aggregated by their full parameter combination. Use this to identify which specific config tuple produces the highest average ROI across multiple runs. Sorted by avg ROI descending.

targets.rawSql: SELECT config_json->>'price_entry' AS "Price Entry", config_json->>'price_scale' AS "Price Scale", config_json->>'amount_scale' AS "Amount Scale", (config_json->>'number_of_orders')::int AS "# Orders", config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' AS "TP %", COUNT(*) AS "Runs", ROUND(AVG(roi)::numeric, 4) AS "Avg ROI %", ROUND(MAX(roi)::numeric, 4) AS "Best ROI %", ROUND(AVG(max_drawdown)::numeric, 4) AS "Avg Drawdown %", ROUND(AVG(win_rate)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Win Rate %" FROM sweep_run_summaries WHERE session_id::text = '${session_id}' AND config_json->>'price_entry' IN (${price_entry:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'price_scale' IN (${price_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'amount_scale' IN (${amount_scale:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'number_of_orders' IN (${number_of_orders:singlequote}) AND config_json->>'take_profit_distance_percent' IN (${take_profit_distance_percent:singlequote}) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 ORDER BY AVG(roi) DESC LIMIT 200
